item.text:
Migrated the two pages to the App Router. The home page is now [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx), the about page is [app/about/page.tsx](/workspace/app/about/page.tsx), and [app/layout.tsx](/workspace/app/layout.tsx) provides the shared HTML structure and metadata. Page titles and descriptions use App Router metadata, and internal links use `next/link`. I removed the `pages` directory.

`npm run build` passed. I also served the production build and confirmed that `/` and `/about` return HTTP 200 with the expected content and metadata.
